errors.text_span: Die dunkelgraue Linie beginnt bei etwa 4,9 Eurocent/kWh
errors.evidence: The description states that the dark grey line starts at approximately 4.9 Eurocent/kWh. However, the chart shows it starting at the same value as the light grey line, which is approximately 5.05 Eurocent/kWh. The purple line is the one that starts at 4.9 Eurocent/kWh.

errors.text_span: Die violette Linie beginnt bei etwa 4,9 Eurocent/kWh und steigt auf etwa 5,3 Eurocent/kWh bei einer Bonushöhe von 0,4 Eurocent/kWh, um dann auf demselben Niveau zu bleiben.
errors.evidence: The description states that the purple line rises to about 5.3 Eurocent/kWh. The chart shows this line rising to a point halfway between the 5.2 and 5.3 gridlines, which corresponds to a value of approximately 5.25 Eurocent/kWh.
The description fails to mention that all three lines are horizontal between the x-axis values of 0 and 0.2 before their trends diverge. This initial flat segment is a key feature of the data shown.
